deadline.value: PhD in Molecular Engineering: November 30, 2026. The separate PhD in Quantum Science and Engineering is due December 14, 2026.
deadline.quote: For the PhD in Molecular Engineering, the application deadline is Monday, November 30, 2026 (11:59 p.m., US Central Time)

gre_general.value: No PME program accepts or reviews the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: Do not take the GRE general test; none of our programs accept or will review the GRE general test.

gre_subject.value: The Molecular Engineering application accepts no GRE scores; only the Quantum track may submit an optional Physics, Mathematics or Chemistry Subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The Molecular Engineering application does not accept GRE scores in any form for admission.

supervisor.value: You list at least two PME faculty of interest but do not have to contact them; students are not assigned a lab at admission and find an advisor after arriving.
supervisor.quote: Applicants do not have to contact faculty as part of the admission and application process.

funding.value: Standard package gives full tuition, a living stipend and health insurance for the duration of the PhD while in good academic standing.
funding.quote: will receive a standard UChicago PME PhD funding package that provides full financial support for the duration of your studies, if you remain in good academic standing

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the requirement; admitted students enter the PhD directly with no pre-doctoral year.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree (usually with a major in a STEM field)

also.quote: Once students are admitted, they are directly admitted into the PhD program. There is no pre-doctoral work.

notes: Covers the PhD in Molecular Engineering (materials for sustainability, immunoengineering and bioengineering, quantum). PME has its own application. The PhD in Quantum Science and Engineering is a separate PME program.
name: PhD in Molecular Engineering
